scientific_integrity: Full proof for every admissible parameter plus finite independent truth-table and interval-extremum checks. The finite tests do not certify the unbounded statement.
scientific_limitations: The exact numerical formula is for path skeletons. Arbitrary finite trees receive a characterization of shattered supports, not a general closed dimension formula; only static VC shattering is addressed. Historical priority and independent validation remain open.
title: Private-edge shattering and the exact long-range reachability dimension of paths
